2027 TAICEP Spring Webinar Series
Advance Your Expertise with the TAICEP Spring Webinar Series
Join a global community of your peers for the TAICEP Spring Webinar Series, a premier training and development opportunity for professionals in international credential evaluation. This series will provide critical training and connection opportunities for our diverse community, which includes professionals from higher education institutions, independent evaluation agencies, ENIC/NARIC offices, government ministries, and licensing and awarding bodies. Building on the success of our highly rated past events, this series is designed to deliver timely insights and practical skills.
The 2027 Series theme is Back to Basics: Country Systems.

When:

Cancellation, Photography, Other Terms & Conditions
TAICEP Spring Webinar Series Cancellation Terms
TAICEP reserves the right to alter or cancel, without prior notice, any of the arrangements relating directly or indirectly to its annual Spring Webinar Series for any circumstances beyond TAICEP’s reasonable control. TAICEP will not accept liability for any losses and/or damages registered participants may suffer because of any alteration or cancellation.
Registered participants may receive a refund of registration costs paid to TAICEP minus the following cancellation fees:
A. $50 fee if the attendee cancels one day before the webinar series begins. This fee helps offset TAICEP’s per-attendee administrative costs.
B. No refunds will be made if the attendee cancels on or after the first day of the webinar series.
Attendee substitutions are permitted without penalty but must be made in advance of the webinar series starting. Requests should be sent via email to answers@taicep.org.
Photo and Video Release
By attending and/or presenting in the TAICEP Spring Webinar Series, you consent to photography, audio recording, video recording, interviews and its/their release, publication, exhibition, or reproduction to be used for news, promotional purposes, advertising, inclusion on websites, or any other purpose by TAICEP. You release TAICEP and all persons involved from any liability connected with the taking, recording, digitizing, or publication of interviews, photographs, computer images, video and/or sound recordings.
